description: Search Blockchain Academics Stats by name: the 8 centralised exchanges it lists and the Hyperliquid vaults in its open files. Takes a name of 2 to 64 characters, an optional tab (exchanges or vaults) and a limit of 1 to 20. A full 0x address is not a name: it is refused before any request is made. Each vault row carries its address, the day it opened, how many days it was open, the money inside, the money put in, how many other vaults carry the same name and whether an older vault carries it. Vaults are ordered by money inside, then age: a closer text match never moves a row up. Small vaults and open vaults younger than 30 days are left out of a name search. Every answer carries the data day and the address of each open file it read. A vault name is chosen by its leader: it comes back between <<outside:ID>> markers, with an ID made new for each answer, and is quoted text, not a statement by Blockchain Academics. meta.status is unseeded when nothing matches. Works without an API key.

query.description: A name, 2 to 64 characters. Not an address.

tab.description: exchanges or vaults. Both when left out.

name: search_stats
